summary: Oportun Financial Corp filed an 8-K on June 22, 2026, regarding a settlement agreement with activist investor Bradley L. Radoff and The Radoff Family Foundation. Under the agreement, two current Class I directors will retire by the 2026 annual meeting; the Radoff Parties are subject to a standstill limiting beneficial ownership to under 4.9% of voting securities, with proxy solicitation and extraordinary transaction restrictions. During the Restricted Period (through ~15 days before 2028 nomination deadline), they must vote in line with Board recommendations, except when ISS and Glass Lewis recommendations conflict, or on extraordinary transactions. The company reimburses the Radoff Parties' reasonable expenses. This resolves the activist campaign; watch for board composition changes and any future activist moves.
